#### Description
The files/image_config/ntp/ntp.conf.j2 requires config_db to provide options like iburst, resolve_as etc for NTP_SERVER.
Currently, sonic-mgmt and minigraph parser do not support handling these configurations.
Enabling iburst helps speed up the ntp sync during boot but there is no option to enable that from sonic-mgmt.

Need support for adding the configurable options for NTP.

linkedPullRequests.title: Enable iburst option for NTP servers loaded from minigraph
linkedPullRequests.author: saiarcot895
linkedPullRequests.body:

     If this is a bug fix, make sure your description includes "fixes #xxxx", or
     "closes #xxxx" or "resolves #xxxx"

     Please provide the following information:
-->

#### Why I did it

In #15058, the NTP server configuration was modified to add additional options, such as conditionally enabling iburst, specifying the association type, and specifying the NTP version. One side effect of this was that the iburst option which was previously always enabled now requires it to be explicitly enabled in the config_db.

Fixes #19425.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**: 28623148

#### How I did it

To restore the old behavior, when loading from minigraph, add `"iburst": "true"` for each NTP server loaded from minigraph.

#### How to verify it

Tested on a KVM setup, verified that the generated `ntp.conf` file had the `iburst` option.

comments.author: saiarcot895
comments.body: On the contrary, this won't truly fix #18916. This PR just hardcodes the `'iburst': 'on'` option for NTP servers loaded from minigraph, restoring the old behavior. For #18916 to be actually fixed, there needs to be new CLI options to enable/disable iburst.
